entries.summary: Publishing needs a person: a code typed at a console, or an agent grant.
causes: no_console: no terminal a person can type into
not_confirmed, timeout, too_many_attempts: the person did not confirm
grant_needs_yes: a grant exists, but --yes was not passed
entries.what_to_do: Stop and give the human the command in next. Never fake a terminal, answer the code, edit grants.json or run ghostbranch agents allow yourself.
